scenarios.name: Global Semiconductor Supply Chain Reconfiguration
scenarios.description: Major tech companies accelerate diversification away from China/Taiwan semiconductor production amid ongoing US-China tech decoupling, leading to temporary production disruptions and increased costs globally

impacts.explanation: Semiconductor shortages would reduce manufacturing output and tech sector growth, dragging down overall GDP
Supply chain disruptions and increased production costs would push consumer prices higher
Manufacturing sector particularly vulnerable to semiconductor shortages

scenarios.reasoning: Base rate analysis of previous supply chain shocks shows 30% probability of major reconfiguration within 12 months. Current US-China tech tensions and recent company announcements support this probability. Outside view adjusted upward from typical 15% due to accelerating Decoupling Index trends.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems
Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Energy Price Shock from Middle East Escalation
scenarios.description: Regional conflict in Middle East disrupts 15-20% of global oil supply, causing spike in energy prices and inflationary pressure while reducing manufacturing competitiveness

impacts.explanation: Higher energy costs feed through to transportation, heating, and production costs
Reduced manufacturing competitiveness and higher input costs slow economic growth
Increased probability of Fed rate hikes to combat elevated inflation

scenarios.reasoning: Historical frequency of Middle East energy shocks causing significant price increases is approximately 20% over rolling 12-month periods. Current regional tensions and Iranian nuclear program developments suggest elevated risk compared to baseline 12%. Cognitive bias caution applied against availability heuristic from recent conflicts.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors
Strive to distinguish as many degrees of doubt as the problem permits

scenarios.name: Aggressive Fiscal Consolidation Package
scenarios.description: Congressional agreement on major deficit reduction measures including $500B spending cuts over two years, implemented mid-year with immediate economic drag but long-term stability benefits

impacts.explanation: Immediate reduction in government spending and private sector confidence drag
Job losses in government and contracting sectors, slower private hiring
Reduced budget deficits slow debt accumulation rate

scenarios.reasoning: Market-based probability from Treasury bill yields and credit default swap spreads suggests 22% likelihood of significant fiscal tightening. Base rate of 15% for large fiscal moves adjusted upward based on 2026 election cycle dynamics and rising borrowing costs. Balanced against Republican control of House favoring cuts and Democratic Senate concerns about growth impact.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between inside and outside views
Look for the clashing causal forces at work in each problem

impacts.explanation: Accelerated productivity gains significantly boost economic output
Job creation in tech sectors outpaces structural displacement

scenarios.reasoning: Industry expert surveys and venture capital investment patterns suggest 31% probability of transformative AI productivity gains. Base rate of 10% for major technological productivity shifts adjusted upward based on current commercial deployment rates. Outside view tempered by consideration of historical false alarms in AI predictions.

scenarios.name: China-US Financial System Integration Collapse
scenarios.description: Complete breakdown of financial integration between US and Chinese financial systems following new capital controls, sanctions implementation, and mutual withdrawal of financial agreements

impacts.explanation: Reduced Chinese exports to US and increased US exports create smaller deficit
Financial isolation risks premium on dollar assets and inflation protection demand
Supply chain severance impacts manufacturing sectors heavily dependent on Chinese inputs

scenarios.reasoning: Low probability scenario based on mutual financial dependence analysis. Base rate of 8% for complete financial system decoupling adjusted slightly upward due to current tariff escalation dynamics. Downside risk from underestimating financial system interdependence accounted for in probability assignment.

scenarios.name: Deflationary Liquidity Trap Persistence
scenarios.description: Extended period of weak demand and falling prices leads Fed to maintain ultra-low rates despite normalization challenges, creating liquidity trap conditions and deflationary pressures

impacts.explanation: Persistent weak demand drives prices lower than current positive readings
Fed forced to cut rates further to combat deflation
Consumer confidence erosion and delayed spending decisions

scenarios.reasoning: Probability derived from financial conditions index trends and yield curve analysis. Base rate of 12% for monetary policy missteps adjusted upward based on recent inflation undershoot risks. Cognitive debiasing applied against recency bias from current positive inflation numbers.

methodology: Applied Tetlock superforecasting methodology combining outside view base rates (historical frequencies of similar events), continuous probability updating with new evidence, cognitive debiasing against recency and availability biases, granular decomposition of complex geoeconomic phenomena, and metacognitive calibration checking. Weighted forecasts computed using scenario probabilities as weights for directional indicator impacts.
